statements.text:
Congratulations to Dr. Tripathi on his remarkable tenure at @UBuffalo.

Throughout my time in public service, he has been a steadfast partner in advancing the University at Buffalo, reaching new heights in education, research, and, most recently, as a leader in AI innovation, as well as leading the charge for successful passage of SUNY 2020.

As he prepares to step down in July 2026, his lasting impact on the University and our community is clear. All of WNY is deeply grateful for his service.

Great way to start the day at the @NotreDame Washington Office with alumni, friends, and some incredibly impressive students from the Student Policy Network.

These young leaders are already tackling big challenges, from affordable housing and AI to human rights, environmental protection, and labor rights – doing it with the kind of rigor and purpose we need more of in public service.

As a proud Irish American and public servant, I couldn’t be more encouraged. The future is in good hands when the next generation is this engaged, thoughtful, and committed to building a better country.

What does the community want? I think the community needs to be front-and-center, giving input. The government leaders that are working closely with the community members have to have those conversations, bring the community in, and make sure that whatever is done at that site is reflective of the desire and the need for the community.
